full_details: The loaf was still two fingers short, and still a penny. At two you were in Titus, and the gown had no new name. After it John opened the boxes he had kept shut since Monday. Your share was two-and-thirty shillings, said once. Margery brought no figure from her stair. The court money is not in the box. Quiney's pound is not in it. From Monday there are five mornings at nine for the lovers, and the sixth is the opening. You are not playing them this week. At home you wrote the share and no total under it, and you turned both locks. Michaelmas is still the last count. You did not start another page.
one_sentence: You were in Titus, and the reckoning was two-and-thirty shillings.
title: Two-and-thirty shillings, said once
